SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) receipts, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id<900 THEN 'store' WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'other'||s.store_id END grp,
  f.staff_purchase_flag staff, (p.category='ZZ Test') test,
  count(*) line_cnt, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, count(DISTINCT s.store_id||'-'||f.receipt_id) store_receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net,
  min(d.calendar_date) mn, max(d.calendar_date) mx, count(DISTINCT d.fiscal_period) periods
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date_hel
  FROM fact_web_order o),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_date) sd, max(sale_date) sd2, sum(net_amount) net, count(*) n, max(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_test, min(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) all_test
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.status, (l.receipt_id IS NOT NULL) has_lines, (o.order_date_hel = l.sd) date_match, (l.sd<>l.sd2) multi_date, coalesce(l.has_test,0) has_test, coalesce(l.all_test,0) all_test,
  count(*) orders, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) dist_orders, sum(l.net) net
FROM o JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=o.order_date_hel LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, sum(f.net_amount) net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, business_date sale_date, receipts, net_sales_before_returns net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900),
mixed AS (SELECT count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1))
SELECT (SELECT sum(receipts) FROM mine) mine_rec, (SELECT sum(receipts) FROM ctl) ctl_rec, (SELECT sum(net) FROM mine) mine_net, (SELECT sum(net) FROM ctl) ctl_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING (store_id, sale_date) WHERE m.net IS DISTINCT FROM c.net OR m.receipts IS DISTINCT FROM c.receipts) mismatched_store_days,
 (SELECT n FROM mixed) mixed_receipts

SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_period_label a, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) d FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period<=3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'anom', CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount<=0) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity<=0) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE store_key IS NULL OR product_key IS NULL) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount>2000) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
